index.summary: DogdouSpec v1 repository-local iteration-first specification and task system.

product.objective: A repository-local, iteration-first specification and task management engine built with C# on .NET 10, using XML and XPath 1.0 as the authoritative store and query mechanism without requiring global catalogs, daemon services, GUI dashboards, or MCP dependencies.

deliverable.description: Portable .NET 10 command-line tool (dogdouspec) and Core engine providing all public management verbs.

index.summary: Authoritative XML schemas for iterations, tasks, transactions, and requests.

deliverable.description: XSD v1 schemas (spec.xsd, tasks.xsd, transaction.xsd, requests.xsd, workspace.xsd) governing workspace documents.

index.summary: Safe XML/XPath 1.0 query, search, and projection engine.

deliverable.description: Deterministic XPath 1.0 evaluator supporting variable substitution, ds:filter/filter-out member projections, and strict memory/node bounds.

index.summary: Task state machine, atomic idempotency, verification and completion records.

deliverable.description: Task management automation supporting lifecycle transitions, terminal completion predicates, and durable idempotency receipts.

index.summary: Read-only readiness assessment and owner-gated confirmation.

deliverable.description: Deterministic, read-only readiness evaluation and protected, owner-gated confirmation with live-state drift detection.

index.summary: Self-hosting root workspace migration, repository Skill instructions, and dogfood correction loop.

deliverable.description: Repository-root self-hosting migration, checked-in DogdouSpec Skill, and live dogfooding validation loop.

included.item: Authoritative XML schemas and .NET 10 CLI commands.
Single and multi-document atomic commits and crash recovery.
Safe XPath 1.0 query/search/projection engine with memory limits.
Task lifecycle automation, records, and durable idempotency receipts.
Deterministic readiness assessment and owner-gated confirmation.
Root workspace self-hosting and checked-in DogdouSpec Skill.

excluded.item: MCP server or MCP tool surface (v1 non-goal).
Cryptographic signature chains or hash-chain consensus (v1 non-goal).
Global central project catalog or registry (v1 non-goal).

index.summary: Repository-local .NET CLI with no mandatory MCP or global tool install.

requirement.statement: DogdouSpec must operate as a repository-local CLI executable directly via dotnet or wrapper scripts without requiring global tools, background daemons, or MCP integration (docs/V1_CLI_CONTRACT.md, docs/V1_DESIGN.md).
requirement.rationale: Ensures portable, self-contained development in any CI or paired agent environment.

index.summary: Iteration-first date-prefixed directory layout without mandatory project.xml.

requirement.statement: Workspaces must organize work into date-prefixed iteration directories (YYYYMMDD-name), each containing spec.xml and tasks.xml, eliminating root project.xml bottlenecks (docs/V1_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_ITERATION_FIRST.md).
requirement.rationale: Prevents monolithic merge contention and establishes clear temporal work boundaries.

index.summary: Authoritative XML/XSD data store, XPath 1.0 variable evaluation, index-first search, and projection.

requirement.statement: XML documents must be validated against XSD schemas, and queries must support XPath 1.0 variables, ds:filter/filter-out projections, and strict limits without silent truncation (docs/V1_XML_SCHEMA_CONTRACT.md).
requirement.rationale: Guarantees schema correctness, token efficiency for LLM agent pairs, and prevents context exhaustion.

index.summary: Revision-checked append, task update durable idempotency, and multi-document transaction recovery.

requirement.statement: Mutations must check expected revisions, persist durable idempotency receipts, and support atomic multi-document transactions with crash recovery (docs/V1_DESIGN.md).
requirement.rationale: Protects document integrity against concurrent writes, partial failures, and agent retry replay.

index.summary: Product authority boundary: automated task completion never closes requirements/iterations.

requirement.statement: Task automation must never auto-complete product requirements or iterations; readiness must be read-only; confirmation must be an explicit owner-gated protected write (docs/V1_CLI_CONTRACT.md).
requirement.rationale: Maintains a strict boundary between technical task progress and human product acceptance.

index.summary: Self-hosting workspace migration with checked-in repository Skill and dogfood review loop.

requirement.statement: The DogdouSpec repository must self-host its own workspace using the public CLI, with a checked-in repository Skill to guide ongoing development (docs/V1_SKILL_WORKFLOW.md).
requirement.rationale: Ensures real-world dogfooding and establishes a complete reference implementation.

acceptance.criterion: build.cmd builds all projects and runs 541+ tests cleanly with zero warnings and zero failures.
All workspace XML documents strictly conform to authoritative v1 schemas with prospective validation.
XPath query and search commands support variable substitution and projections with enforced size limits.
Task update helper enforces state machine transitions and durable idempotency receipts.
Readiness assessment is read-only and deterministic; confirmation acts as the owner authority gate.
Root workspace operates natively through CLI with repository Skill providing interactive workflow guidance.

design.overview: Architectural principles and design decisions governing DogdouSpec v1.

boundaries.boundary: Repository-local operation without daemons or global catalogs.
Strict XML schema validation and single-source-of-truth document model.

decision.rationale: Organizing work by date-prefixed iterations eliminates centralized project.xml contention and isolates task graphs.

index.summary: Strict bounds on document size, XPath output, and projected nodes.

decision.rationale: Authoritative limits prevent memory exhaustion and context window overflow during LLM agent interactions.

index.summary: Durable idempotency verified against pre-commit revision, timestamp, and live state.

decision.rationale: Deep verification ensures replay succeeds when state is unchanged and returns conflict if subsequent mutations have drifted.

index.summary: Owner authority boundary enforced at Skill invocation and confirmation level.

decision.rationale: Technical agents cannot auto-confirm product decisions; confirmation provenance is recorded with actor attribution.

confirmation.summary: Explicit owner instruction authorized activating DogdouSpec v1 iteration and approving baseline requirements and architectural decisions for self-hosting migration.
